title: A Sunday by the Sea
text:
Ali rides his bike to school every day. The bike is red and very fast. On Sundays, his family goes to the seaside by bus. They sit near the window and look at the sea.

The bus stops near the beach. Ali's sister buys tickets at a small shop. Then they walk to the sand and swim all afternoon. The day is always fun.

questions.text: How does Ali go to school?
How does the family probably feel on Sundays?
What can we infer about Ali's sister?
options: She helps the family during the trip.
She is afraid of the sea.

vocabulary.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pedalling
the area of land next to the sea
small papers or cards that you buy to travel or to enter a place
very small pieces of rock found on beaches

paragraph_translations: Ali her gün bisikletiyle okula gider. Bisiklet kırmızı ve çok hızlıdır. Pazar günleri ailesi otobüsle deniz kenarına gider. Pencerenin yanında otururlar ve denize bakarlar.
Otobüs deniz kenarının yakınında durur. Ali'nin ablası küçük bir dükkândan bilet alır. Sonra kumsala yürürler ve öğleden sonra boyunca yüzerler. Gün her zaman eğlencelidir.
